# 2 Baruch Chapter 46 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Dialogue

---

**1** After saying all this to the people, Baruch told them: "Very soon I am going to leave you. After everything that has happened, I will be taken away from this place."

**2** "I know that the land of Israel will lie desolate, that Zion will be abandoned, that the sacred vessels will be hauled away, and that our people will be scattered among the nations."

**3** "But do not mourn over these things. The time is coming when everything taken away will be restored, the ruins rebuilt, and the scattered people gathered back together."

**4** "I know they will serve their enemies in exile, and their children will learn the customs of foreign peoples. But do not despair — the law stays with you."

**5** "I am going to join my fathers, just as Moses departed and left Aaron and Joshua behind. I am leaving Gedaliah son of Ahikam with you."

**6** "Listen to him — he will guide you. Do not forget the law. Teach it to those who are wise, so they will never turn away from it."

**7** When Baruch had finished speaking to all the people, he got up and went off to the oak tree at Mamre.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Prioritizes clarity and natural English flow while preserving the theological and narrative content of the Syriac source.*
